_readme: A starter file, not a roster. It gives a newly installed app the three team labels so you are not typing them on a phone. Players are added in the app itself, on the Roster tab, and stay on the device that added them. See ROSTER.md.
_privacy: NO PLAYER NAMES IN THIS FILE, EVER. It is published on the open web at the app's address and anyone can read it, and anything committed here stays in the public git history for good even if it is deleted later. Player names live only on each coach's phone. If you ever do add players here, give them jersey numbers and nothing else — a test enforces it.
